content.title: Westminster Confession of Faith
content.author: Westminster Assembly · OPC text
content.note: The historic confession of Presbyterian and Reformed churches, written by the Westminster Assembly in 1646 and 1647. These guides cite it beside the Baptist confession of 1689, which follows it closely but differs above all on the covenants, the church and baptism. Citations specify chapter and paragraph. The site’s own doctrinal standard is the Baptist Faith and Message 2000, and Scripture judges every confession (1.10).
